slug: 2025-10-27 Cameroon's BUNEC partners with Liber Technologies for CRVS digitization

facts.fact: BUNEC partnered with Liber Technologies in October 2025 to build a fully digital civil registration system by 2029, integrated with the new biometric national ID, per Biometric Update.

CMR.note: Law 2024/016 provides a UPIN for every citizen, but the document does not tie it to birth registration.
Only a mention of the 'new biometric national ID' with no status stated.
